name: GoHighLevel
description: GoHighLevel (HighLevel) is a CRM and marketing platform with a v3 API and an MCP server.
auth_notes: Private Integration Token for internal single-sub-account use; OAuth 2.0 (authorization_code, refresh_token, client_credentials) for public integrations; tokens sent as Bearer.
gate_detail: Sources describe the two auth types but not how to obtain a token, plan requirements or approvals. The OAuth page mentions a client_id and client_secret provided for your integration. No sandbox stated.
api_scope: v3 API covering CRM resources such as contacts, conversations, opportunities, calendars and payments, with sub-account and company level access via OAuth tokens.
mcp_notes: HighLevel MCP Server (also called LeadConnector MCP) connects via OAuth and exposes four tools; documented by HighLevel.
blocker_detail: Credential acquisition path, plan requirements and any app review are not stated in the sources.
